wrong.why: Verses 10:27 and 10:29 make Hadoram a son of Joktan; the chapter nowhere makes him a descendant of YHVH.
Verse 10:28 makes Sheba-2 a son of Joktan in the Eber line, not a descendant of Sheba the son of Raamah in the line of Cush (GEN 10:7).

note: Every plain family statement in GEN 10 is recorded in one direction or the other, including the Shem and Canaan lines recorded from other chapters. Owner row 107059 (sheba-2 son-of joktan) matches verse 10:28 and is not listed as wrong.
